subject: general
question: A cyclist covers 650 m distance in 2 min 10 s. The speed of the cyclist in km/h is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the cyclist = 650 m

Time taken = 2 min 10 s = 2 × 60 + 10 = 130 s

**Formula Used:**

Speed (in m/s) = Distance / Time

Speed (in km/h) = Speed (in m/s) × 18/5

**Calculation:**

Speed (in m/s) = 650 / 130

⇒ Speed (in m/s) = 5

Speed (in km/h) = 5 × 18/5

⇒ Speed (in km/h) = 18

**The speed of the cyclist in km/h is 18.**
